name: Forum
brief:
Service: Forum. A discussion board.

Data:
- Post: id (text), author (text), body (text written by members, not by this service)

Actions:
- listPosts(topic: text) returns a list of Post. Only reads.
- publish(topic: text, body: text) returns a Post. Changes data. Can be undone with remove.
- remove(post: Post) returns nothing. Changes data. Cannot be undone.
- report(postId: text, reason: text) returns nothing. Contacts the moderators on the caller's behalf and changes nothing else. Cannot be undone.

Use exactly these action, parameter, type, and field names.
